name: Stephen
overview: Stephen was chosen as one of seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, to oversee the daily ministry of the early church (Acts 6:3,5). He was empowered by faith and the Holy Spirit to perform great wonders and miracles among the people (Acts 6:8). Despite opposition and false accusations from various synagogue groups, Stephen's wisdom and spirit enabled him to speak with authority that his adversaries could not resist (Acts 6:9-10). His life exemplifies a faithful servant empowered by God to serve and witness boldly in the face of opposition.
